## Audit Report: Calendar (M10)

**Finding:**

`machtzev/generator/apps/calendar.json:63` · Field "משך בדקות" declared as type **"text"** but task requires **numeric field**; will silently coerce non-numeric input to 0 in compute formula (line 51 of gen_app_calendar_ent1.dart: `num.tryParse(_v[5] ?? '') ?? 0`)  
**Severity: P1 (wrong result)** — Data type inconsistency  
**Fix:** Change `"type": "text"` to `"type": "num"` for the "משך בדקות" field

---

**Verified Correct:**

✅ Spec line updated correctly with both field names and formula  
✅ Computed field formula is valid Dart: `((num.tryParse(_v[5] ?? '') ?? 0) / 60).toStringAsFixed(2)`  
✅ Field count correct (7 total); labels match content file  
✅ Required/optional flags correct (only original 2 fields required)  
✅ UI surfaces complete (form, list card, table, CSV export)  
✅ All compile checks pass (0 errors, 53 gates green)  
✅ No collateral damage to other specs  

The police report claims "משך בדקות (numeric)" but the actual JSON has type "text"—this gap was not caught by the machine checks (dart_math_sane and field checks only validate formulas and counts, not input field types). The code will run without errors, but accepts any string input and silently defaults to 0 if parsing fails.

Coverage: Audit examined spec syntax, generated labels, formula arithmetic, field mappings in form/display layers, and surface inclusion. Cannot verify runtime widget behavior or actual form input validation without running the app.
